question: Which equal eight-thread allocation maximizes batch throughput while matching the decoded baseline frames?
baseline: one Blender process using eight threads, alternating the two pilot scenes
test: Compare median valid frames/minute. Require all decoded pixels to match the isolated baseline. Startup and PNG output are inside the timed region; output validation is outside it.
falsifier: Any mismatch invalidates that layout. Less than 5% advantage means retain the simpler configuration.
limitation: Concurrent host processes, warm caches, repeated frame 65, preview quality, tmpfs, no simultaneous editing load.
